input.reasoning_summary: All three challenges were refuted by the evidence. H1 challenged whether revenues actually decreased - the numeric check confirmed revenues were $94,827 million in 2025 vs $97,690 million in 2024, a decrease of 2.93%. H2 looked for accounting changes or restatements affecting comparability - while there were mentions of one-time FSD recognition differences, these were operational items that don't affect the comparability of the revenue figures themselves, and no accounting changes or restatements were found. H3 challenged whether energy segment growth offset automotive declines - evidence shows energy revenue increased $2.69 billion while automotive sales decreased $6.66 billion, so the energy increase was insufficient to offset automotive declines. The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains correct: Tesla's total revenues for fiscal year 2025 ($94.827 billion) decreased compared to fiscal year 2024 ($97.690 billion).
